commons-precincts: Minnesota General Election Results, 2022-2030: General Election Results By Precinct 2024 (Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State, on the Minnesota Geospatial Commons)

notes: Compiled by the Clerk from the states' official returns; used for the federal contests' controls and candidates' names.

The Secretary's metadata: 'Precinct and district attributes from Statewide Voter Registration System (SVRS). Election results certified by State Canvassing Boards. Election statistics certified by County Canvassing Boards.' Published 2025-04-16; latest election canvassed 2024-11-21. The office says it 'cannot assure 100% accuracy'. One row a precinct (4,103); attributes only, read from the Commons' feature service. Dataset page: https://gis.data.mn.gov/datasets/446a973217ce46da9cc96bf43120fbba
gaps: Judges, county offices, soil and water supervisors, cities, townships, school boards, hospital districts and local questions

Minnesota publishes these results statewide only in the Secretary of State's 'Media Files', on results websites that turn automated requests away with a CAPTCHA, so this loader does not ask them. They will be added when a copy of that election's Media Files is saved by hand. The Geospatial Commons table loaded here carries only the federal, statewide and legislative contests.
